ValidationRule.description: Require Credit Allocation Before Close Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(Opportunity_Credit_Allocated__c) ), ISPICKVAL(StageName , "Closed Won"), NOT( Opportunity_Credit_Allocated__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before closing this Opportunity, please confirm Opportunity Credit Allocation field. Add Opportunity Team members and/or Opportunity Splits, or manually check Opportunity Credit Allocation if N/A.
